FC-DMA Multi-Spectral EO/IR PTZ Turret

Applications: Coastal and border defense; low-altitude drone detection and tracking; long-range 24/7 situational awareness; radar-guided autonomous tracking.
Get quotationWhatsApp
The FC-DMA multi-band optical turntable is a long-range optical detection system that can effectively detect, track, identify, and provide early warning for small and medium-sized civilian consumer-grade rotary-wing and fixed-wing drones. It can also achieve all-weather, all-time, full-dimensional discovery, positioning, tracking, identification, and tracking of targets in key areas or for specific targets to provide three-dimensional security protection.
  • Overview
  • Technical Specifications
  • Contact us

Key Features

  • Domestically produced, independently controllable, strong load capacity, capable of achieving ultra-long-distance target observation
  • Wide detection spectrum, multi-band detection complementary advantages, combined active and passive detection, meeting monitoring needs in day and night and all-weather environments
  • High degree of intelligence, supports abnormal behavior detection such as target intrusion detection and motion detection, supports target classification and recognition, and supports functions such as hotspot alarm, radar linkage, and 3D zoom positioning
  • Excellent tracking performance, ensuring stable tracking of targets during rapid flight and direction changes
  • Strong environmental adaptability, IP66 protection, rainproof, dustproof, anti-corrosion, anti-electromagnetic interference, suitable for long-term use in harsh field environments.

Technical Specifications

ParameterDescription
Uncooled Thermal Imaging (Optional)1. Detector: 6th generation uncooled focal plane array VOx detector 2. Resolution: 640×512/1280×1024 optional 3. Wavelength: 8μm～14μm 4. NETD: Better than 40mK (@25℃ F1.0) 5. Lens Focal Length: 21～105mm, 30～120mm, 31～155mm, 23～230mm continuous zoom lens optional; 25～150mm, 30～180mm, 23～230mm HD continuous zoom lens optional 6. Lens Control: Supports motorized zoom, manual/auto focus
Cooled Thermal Imaging (Optional)1. Detector: Cooled focal plane array MCT detector 2. Spectral Range: 3.7μm～4.8μm 3. Resolution: 640×512 4. NETD: Better than 20mK 5. Lens Focal Length: 15～300mm, 22～450mm, 30～600mm, 40～800mm, 90～1100mm continuous zoom lens optional 6. Lens Control: Supports motorized zoom, manual/auto focus
HD Visible Light1. Sensor: Ultra-low illumination starlight-grade CMOS 2. Resolution: 1920×1080 3. Lens Focal Length: 7～300mm, 25～500mm, 12.5～750mm, 16.7～1000mm HD motorized zoom lens optional 4. Lens Control: Supports motorized zoom, manual/auto focus 5. Image Enhancement: Supports wide dynamic range, strong light suppression, electronic image stabilization, 3D digital noise reduction, auto white balance and other functions 6. Defogging: Supports electronic dual defogging
Laser Illumination1. Wavelength: 808nm/940nm 2. Power: 808nm: 10W/15W/20W/25W optional, 940nm: 10W/18W optional 3. Illumination Angle: 1.14°～28°/0.46°～22.6°/0.4°～30° optional 4. Illumination Distance: 1000m/3000m
Laser Ranging1. Ranging Range: 50m～3000m/50m～5000m/100m～10000m 2. Ranging Accuracy: ±3m 3. Frequency: 1Hz
Servo Turntable1. Structure: U-shaped, two-axis two-frame 2. Horizontal Range: N×360° continuous rotation, can be mechanically locked after power off 3. Tilt Range: -90°～+90°, with soft limit function, programmable 4. Rotation Speed: Horizontal 0.01°～80°/s, Tilt 0.01°～60°/s 5. Positioning Accuracy: Better than 0.02° 6. Presets: No less than 255
Tracking Function1. Tracking Method: Front-end embedded hardware tracking or back-end software tracking 2. Tracking Function: Supports multi-target detection, auto-capture, brief occlusion, etc.
Intelligent Analysis (Optional)1. Abnormal Behavior Detection: Supports region intrusion detection, tripwire intrusion detection, motion detection, cruise detection, as well as loitering detection, gathering detection, stay detection, reverse direction detection, etc. 2. Classification and Recognition: Supports classification and recognition of targets such as people, vehicles, and drones (requires customer assistance to provide datasets)
Interfaces1. Power Supply Interface: AC220V to DC48V 2. Communication Interface: 1-ch RJ45 network port
Power Consumption1. Power Consumption: Max ≤500W, stable ≤150W
Weight1. Weight: ≤65kg (excluding optical load)
Dimensions1. Dimensions: 572mm×472mm×655mm (reference, specifically depends on configuration)
Environmental Adaptability1. Working Temperature: -40℃～60℃ 2. Working Humidity: ≤95% RH 3. Protection Level: IP66
Customization1. Supports customized function development
